The institutional investor held 41,905 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.90M, up from 19,260 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greatmark Investment Partners Inc who had been investing in Lowe’s Companies Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $72.16B market cap company.
